title: Distributed lock in Redis never released after worker crash
cause: Lock acquired without TTL/expiry, so a crashed owner cannot release it.
solution: Acquire with SET key token NX EX seconds; release only via compare-and-delete of the token; prefer a maintained library for fencing. Size EX to max critical-section time with margin.
workaround: Manual DEL by operators during incidents after verifying no live owner.
